name: LAB. CORP.OF AMER. DL-,10
summary: LAB. CORP.OF AMER. DL-,10, also known as Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings, is a global life sciences company providing comprehensive clinical laboratory and drug development services. The company operates a network of laboratories and provides testing services to physicians, hospitals, managed care organizations, and pharmaceutical companies. Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings is headquartered in Burlington, North Carolina.
